post.description: Chain-native drop-in: send the exact body you would POST to <chain>/GetCompositePool ({ token0, token1, fee } with object-form token class keys) and receive the raw GalaChainResponse ({ Status, Data }) verbatim — front-cached (shared with /quote), so switching to this URL adds caching transparently.
